name: Truth in UI
goal: Nothing lies to the player; every gate and tool is visible before the click. Directly kills the named complaints 'Forge gate invisible', 'can only craft a fishing rod', and 'tools do nothing'.
deliverables: Make tileForArtisan surface hasWorkbench() and gateOk() with persistent locked tile states (Build the Forge / Needs recipe scroll)
Add a bench banner to the artisan header routing to House -> Farmstead -> Forge
Surface the active tool name+bonus on gather/artisan tiles (e.g. 'Willow Rod +5%')
Fix combat preview to read d.ch with real percentages
Fix combat preview forecast to call getPlayerCombatRolls/getMonsterCombatRolls instead of the wrong formula
Smoke tests: Forge-less save shows smithing tiles locked; preview odds equal drop table

name: Repair the broken loops
goal: No dead rewards, no inert flagship items, one source of truth. Fixes the P0 and the honesty violations.
deliverables: P0: wire upgradeRoom to consume housing blueprints
Add a damage buff reader in maxHit so Cooked Shark/Swordfish/Bear Claw Pie are honest
Add cook_turnip recipe
Give gold_bar a real jewelry/gem sink
Delete the four stale duplicate blocks (inline MONSTERS, ITEMS food twin, Phase A.1 recipes, dead renderArtisanActivities) and add divergence smoke tests
Fix the stale power-budget.js no-reader comment

name: Tools become real
goal: A tool changes the loop in a way the player can name, for gathering AND artisan skills.
deliverables: Add toolXpB and toolDoubleChance routed through the single activityIntervalMs/produce path
Bump the entry tool tier and/or make a basic tool a soft gather requirement
Introduce artisan tools (hammer/chisel/needle/knife) by extending the d.artisan branch and existing craftSave/yield gating

name: Standardize the reward layer
goal: Bands not magic numbers; one boss schema consumed by every surface; every mat has a sink.
deliverables: Define shared rarity/drop-band constants; replace the three hardcoded 0.05 checks; author drop tables by band
Author src/data/bosses.js and refactor DUNGEONS + Boss of the Day + Hunt to reference boss records by id; reconcile the Marrow King/Bone Lord split
Add a sink-side reachability guard; give every combat mat a recipe or turn-in; retire or convert redundant below-tier monster gear drops

name: Gear identity & combat feel
goal: Make progression horizontal as well as vertical; every gear stat felt; prestige gear plays differently.
deliverables: Give each weapon family a speedMod identity (Warhammer slow/heavy) to end its strict dominance
Bake small crit/spd/passives onto the generated gear ladder per family
Add an armor damage-reduction term to monster maxHit
Rework the accuracy clamp / raise boss & dungeon DEF so weapon atkB matters; steepen the weapon share of max hit
Give Hunt-forged and dungeon signature armor set bonuses/passives; add weakness off-type XP catch-up

name: Dungeon & boss ecosystem
goal: Dungeons are a real grind loop with identity; the daily boss axis is met; the idle buff loop is closed.
deliverables: Add dungeon scrip + quartermaster + per-dungeon signature mats feeding recipes (copy the Hunt loop)
Give each dungeon boss one signature mechanic; build real encounters for voidbringer and ancient_wyrm; replace farm_deed filler
Rotate a real Boss/Dungeon of the Day roster toward the 7+ daily target
Build the deferred drinks/auto-buff consumer and raise buff magnitudes toward the 15% budget
Pacing: break the fishing 20-40 dead zone and finish the coal 30-52 relief
